redFindings.title: Watchdog: Vendor inbox engine has gone silent
redFindings.body:
**Vendor inbox engine** has produced nothing for longer than its allowed window.

- Allowed silence: 36h
- Actual silence: never
- It has never written a heartbeat.

Why it matters: Twice daily. Reads vendor mail and acts on breakage. BLOCKED on the Gmail connector, which needs a one-time human OAuth consent; it cannot run in CI until then.

This engine runs outside GitHub Actions, so nothing here can restart it. If it lives on a laptop, that is the bug, not the symptom.
